marginalia.note: Videtur excusatus effe a fuci-ndo quod juravit, licet tene-atur facere quod in se est. Aquin. 2.2.qu.89. 7.

page.notes: Left-edge strip cut off: "Iafim", "onducere", "eticeatur" and "em plenam" are partly lost and uncertain. "ju-rantem" at the line end is uncertain. The Greek words "σεβάσεως" and "ἐπιορκίας" are doubtful readings. The margin note "2.2.qu.89. 7." is read as printed; "7." may be "art. 7.". The mark "a" in the text is printed as "ª". Long s has been transcribed as plain s.
